import pandas as pd

# Calculate the rolling mean of the 'Dagger' column with a window size of 50 years
time_series_df['Dagger_rolling_mean'] = time_series_df['Dagger'].rolling(window=50).mean()

# Identify the point at which the rolling mean begins to increase significantly
# We will look for the first year where the rolling mean increases by more than 1 standard deviation
std_dev = time_series_df['Dagger'].std()
threshold = std_dev * 1

# Find the first year where the rolling mean increases by more than 1 standard deviation
for index, row in time_series_df.iterrows():
    if index > 50:  # Skip the first 50 years to ensure the rolling mean is calculated
        if row['Dagger_rolling_mean'] - time_series_df.iloc[index - 1]['Dagger_rolling_mean'] > threshold:
            first_significant_increase = row['CE']
            break
